config._comment_server_id: Must not collide with any other connector/replica reading this RDS instance's binlog - including LMS's existing 'eos_test' connector, if it points at the same instance. Confirm the registry of in-use server IDs before assigning one.
config._comment_topic_prefix: Deliberately NOT 'eos_test' - that is LMS's existing connector/topic. A distinct prefix keeps this service's consumer group isolated and avoids either side reprocessing the other's offsets.
config._comment_tables: employee_exit is required, not optional: terminations are written to employee_exit.status, not employee_details.employment_status. A connector on employee_details alone silently misses every termination.
config._comment_key: Keys on the stable business UUID, not the auto-increment 'id' column - matches the correlation key EmployeeCdcConsumer expects.
config._comment_smt: This exact SMT configuration is what LMS's already-merged, production consumer relies on (flattened __op/__ts_ms/__deleted fields, not a nested payload.after envelope). Do not change without updating EmployeeCdcConsumer and EmployeeCdcEvent to match.
config._comment_no_schema_registry: No Avro/Protobuf, no schema registry - matches the existing LMS contract exactly.
